head: 8af2ac69be586b93f0aef046645068896ba3cc77
summary:
This was a stale re-validation. Since attempt 1 (ec19fad..8af2ac6) the tree changed in two places: src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs (ShowVolumeInUse now always goes through ContinueWith and then Dispatcher.InvokeAsync) and tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 (count strings, the C-005 fixture and the C-003 lookahead). No Core file changed. Everything ran non-elevated (Medium integrity, IsInRole(Administrator)=False).

**Results at HEAD 8af2ac6:**
- The Release build is clean.
- The Core suite passed 240/240 (trx).
- Fitness holds all 39 rules, and rules-parity reports AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 24 settled.
- RuleCases C-001 to C-005 all exit 0 with no FAIL (8, 34, 26, 26 and 230 checks), so O-024 holds.
- I did a fresh single-file publish at validate. WindowCases -Case All passed all 28 non-network cases on the new exe, including V-001 (drive-root ending has 4 lines, line 3 'The volume reports 771.1 GB in use…'; folder ending has none) and P-001 (paths past 260 characters).

**Real contact:** the shipped exe scanned all of C:\ in report mode twice.
- Run 2 finished Completed with exit 0 in 653 s: 3,588,756 files, 829,852 folders, 20,464 links not followed, 984.0 GB in files and 717.5 GB on disk, and the unreadable expander shown.
- Its volume line, 'The volume reports 771.1 GB in use, so 53.6 GB of it was not seen', matches Get-Volume read just before and after: 827,930,673,152 B and 827,932,733,440 B, both 771.07 GiB.
- ShowVolumeInUse now has only one path, so this line reached the window through the ContinueWith/dispatcher path O-025 asked for.
- Run 1 also completed with exit 0 and the same totals. My own `-Last 40` pipe cut its volume line, which is why I ran it a second time.
- Both runs took 631–653 s against 464 s at attempt 1. That is slower on the same Core, and I did not investigate why.

**Not rerun this pass:** attempt 1's whole-drive store-versus-FindFirstFileExW comparison. It was run against byte-identical Core code, which git diff confirms.

**Still not reached:** the elevated-token case, the harness cases C-006 to C-014 (they need the TAAD engine checkout, which is outside this worktree), the network cases, and a figure that genuinely lands after the ending on a stalling drive letter.

The worktree is unchanged apart from the pre-existing .taad files, and my scratch files in %TEMP% are deleted.

checks.what: Design case 3: the non-elevation assertion fails in an elevated process
checks.evidence: It needs the project's test run with an elevated token. That is a session only build-slice can declare, not a named operation. The check is the BCL's Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess, and the design marked the case non-material.

checks.what: A volume figure that genuinely lands after the ending (a stalling drive letter)
checks.evidence: No drive letter backed by a stalling volume is reachable without changing SMB mappings. StallRig serves UNC with no letter. Now that the method has only one path, every ending reaches it, but none of them reached it with a late figure.

checks.what: Opt-in network tests (Network=SMB-LOOPBACK / TEST-NET-1) and window cases N-001..N-004
checks.evidence: They are excluded by the default filter and need -IncludeNetwork. They change this machine's SMB client mappings. No criterion of this slice depends on them.

checks.what: Worktree and machine left as found

My %TEMP% files (sl043-v2-results, sl043-v2-window-all.log, sl043-v2-cdrive.txt) are deleted. The older sl043-* items in %TEMP% belong to earlier stages and were left alone.

criteria.criterion: 1. Scan a tree and compare the store with an independent recursive listing: folders and files past 260 characters, deepest over 400, no links, non-elevated process
criteria.how: TraversalTests.AgreesWithAnIndependentListingOfADeepTreeAsAnOrdinaryUser passed in this Release run (240/240). Core is byte-identical to attempt 1, whose whole-C:\ comparison against two FindFirstFileExW walks matched all 4,438,929 stable entries non-elevated.

criteria.criterion: 2. The same comparison when the tree contains a hidden file and a hidden folder
criteria.how: The same Fact passed at this tree. It asserts both hidden entries are in the store with the Hidden attribute, against a reference listing that uses AttributesToSkip=0.

criteria.criterion: 3. The not-elevated check when the token is elevated (TokenIsElevated=1)
criteria.how: This needs an elevated run of the project's own tests, which is a session and not a named operation. The design marked it non-material.

criteria.criterion: 4. Classify as link: reparse attribute plus a surrogate-bit tag (junction, symlink dir and file, 0xA000001D file, 0xA0000010 dir)
criteria.how: EntryClassifierTests.ANameSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsALink passed at this tree. The shipped exe's real C:\ run recorded 20,464 links not followed, the same count as the independent walks at attempt 1.

criteria.criterion: 5. Classify as data: reparse attribute plus a non-surrogate tag (four cloud tags, tag 0, DFS 0x8000000A; file and dir)
criteria.how: EntryClassifierTests.ANonSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsData passed. Real cloud-tagged entries are invisible to a standalone .NET process (U-004), so the cloud rows rest on the table test.

criteria.criterion: 6. Tag field has 0x20000000 but the reparse attribute is clear
7. Record an unreadable folder and continue: 363 or 1920, with and without a requested cancel (5 and 995 alongside)
criteria.how: The SynchronousIoCancelTests 363/1920 rows passed as Unreadable. The shipped exe's real C:\ run Completed with the unreadable expander shown (662 folders).

criteria.criterion: 8. Record used space of a drive-root scan: system drive, cancelled right after the figure lands, Get-Volume read before and after
criteria.how: VolumeUsageTests.ASystemDriveScanRecordsWhatGetVolumeReports passed at this tree. On real data, the exe's C:\ line read 771.1 GB against Get-Volume before and after of 771.07 GiB.

criteria.criterion: 9. Record used space of a folder scan (not a drive root)
criteria.how: AFolderScanRecordsNoFigure passed. In V-001, the folder-path ending on the fresh exe has no volume line.

criteria.criterion: 10. Decide whether a root is a drive root (C:\, c:\, \\?\C:\, C:\Users, UNC forms, a volume mounted on a folder)
criteria.how: The OnlyAWholeDriveIsADriveRoot theory passed. It is a string test only, and no real mounted-folder volume was reached.

criteria.criterion: 11. A drive letter with no volume behind it: GetDiskFreeSpaceExW returns false
12. End a drive-root scan while the volume read is stalled and the scan is cancelled
criteria.how: ADriveRootScanEndsWhileTheReadIsStalled and AStalledReadKeepsNoDroppedScanInMemory passed at this tree.

criteria.criterion: 13. A tree past 260 characters read by the published single-file exe, which has no longPathAware manifest
criteria.how: Window case P-001 passed on the exe published at validate in this pass.

criteria.criterion: 14. The App shows the used figure for a drive-root scan from store.VolumeUsed, with MainWindow's DriveInfo call deleted
criteria.how: V-001 passed on the fresh exe. The real whole-C:\ exe run showed 'The volume reports 771.1 GB in use', matching Get-Volume's 771.07 GiB. Both went through the single ContinueWith/Dispatcher path, which is now the only path. A figure that genuinely arrives after the ending was not produced.

It asserts a non-elevated process, a folder path over 260 characters and a file path over 400, and equal path sets against an independent listing that skips nothing. This was cut as already built. HardlinkTests (three names in three folders) passed in this 240/240 Release run.
This was cut as already built. LinkTests.JunctionsAndSymlinksAreRecordedAndNeverEntered passed in this run. The shipped exe's real C:\ scans ended Completed with 20,464 links not followed.

The EntryClassifierTests table passed at HEAD: the four cloud tags and tag 0 are descended, and junction and symlink are Link. The EntryClassifier code is unchanged since attempt 1's real-data check, where no kind disagreed with the walk.

UnreadableFolderTests (ACL denies list access; error 5 recorded, siblings counted) and the 363/1920 classification rows passed at HEAD. The shipped exe's real C:\ run Completed past 662 unreadable folders, and the expander was shown.

The VolumeUsageTests Get-Volume bracket passed at HEAD. The shipped exe's real C:\ scan showed 'The volume reports 771.1 GB in use'. Get-Volume Size-SizeRemaining read 827,930,673,152 B before and 827,932,733,440 B after, both 771.07 GiB.

obligations.evidence: At HEAD 8af2ac6, RuleCases.ps1 C-001 to C-005 each exit 0 with no FAIL: 8, 34, 26, 26 and 230 ok, each ending 'All checks held.' rules-parity prints 'AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 24 settled', which matches the updated strings. C-006 to C-014 were not run: they need the engine checkout.

MainWindow.xaml.cs:402-404 is now a single figure.ContinueWith(... Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(AddVolumeInUse ...)) with no IsCompleted shortcut. V-001 passed on an exe published at validate, and the real whole-C:\ exe run's volume line (771.1 GB) arrived through that only path. I did not rerun the mutation that builds and reviews used.

not_reached: A volume figure that really lands after the ending, from a mapped drive letter whose volume stalls. The code now has one path for every ending, but no real late figure was produced; StallRig serves UNC with no drive letter.
The elevated-token case: whether the non-elevation assertion goes red in an elevated session. That needs a session of the project's own tests run as administrator, which only build-slice can declare.
A DFS namespace or referral. None is reachable here, so the accepted consequence is unmeasured: descending DFS follows the referral over SMB, and FileIds from another server mix into one table.

Real entries carrying the cloud tags 0x9000201A/401A/601A/E01A. A standalone .NET process on this PC sees OneDrive placeholders as plain entries with tag 0 (U-004), so only the classifier table covers those rows.
A real volume mounted on a folder, and a SUBST or share-subfolder letter reporting its host volume's figure. IsDriveRoot was checked only on strings.
A whole-drive scan of an empty removable drive, where the scanner's own root open lacks SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS and could raise the 'insert a disk' box.
RuleCases harness cases C-006 to C-014. They need the TAAD engine checkout, which is outside this worktree.
The opt-in SMB-loopback and TEST-NET-1 tests and window cases N-001..N-004, which change SMB mappings.
Windows 10. Only Windows 11 build 26200 was available.
Why the whole-C:\ exe scan took 631-653 s here against 464 s at attempt 1 on the same Core code. Not investigated; no criterion bounds scan time.
